whyTitle: Short, memorable, and made for AI.
whyIntro: Four-character .com domains are scarce. In the AI era, aii0 feels right at home as a brand name.
shortTitle: Four characters you can remember at a glance
shortBody: The supply of four-character .com domains is limited and shrinking. A short name is easy to say, easy to spell, and fits on a business card or in a pitch.
aiBody: The prefix “ai” and the final “0” suggest building AI from zero. It suits an AI product, lab, agent project, or independent developer brand.
languageBody: Just letters and a number, with no unusual spelling. It can be read as “ài líng” in Chinese and “AI-Zero” in English, and is easy to say in Chinese, Japanese, and English.

dealTitle: Four steps to complete the sale
dealIntro: Third-party escrow is available throughout. Funds are held securely and released after the domain transfer is confirmed, protecting both parties. The process usually takes 3–7 days.

priceQ: How do we agree on a price? Is there a minimum?
priceA: The price is negotiable. Email your budget range and intended use. Reasonable offers will receive a considered reply, with priority given to serious offers.
escrowQ: What payment methods do you support?
escrowA: Escrow.com is recommended, and major domain marketplaces are also supported. The buyer covers the escrow fee, subject to negotiation. Direct transfers without escrow are not accepted.
timingQ: How long does the transfer take?
timingA: Once the escrow release conditions are met, a transfer between registrars usually takes 1–5 days. A push within the same registrar can be completed the same day. We’ll coordinate the DNS handoff with you in advance.
installmentsQ: Can I lease the domain or pay in installments?
installmentsA: Long-term leases or installment plans may be possible depending on the proposal. Email to discuss the terms. Ownership is transferred after full payment.
